entities.name: Query FtsH protein
observations: 655 aa protein with predicted molecular mass 70.1 kDa and theoretical pI 6.03.
Contains two N-terminal transmembrane helices, approximately residues 29-56 and 129-165, with a large C-terminal cytoplasmic region.
Pfam domains: FtsH_ext (29-128), AAA/AAA_5 (224-358), AAA lid (381-424), and Peptidase_M41 (440-621).
Sequence homology strongly supports ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease FtsH: best reviewed hit D1CDT8 has 58.9% identity over 91.1% query coverage and E-value 4.35e-224.
Likely functions as a membrane-anchored, hexameric AAA+ protease involved in quality control and degradation of membrane or cytoplasmic proteins.
FtsH homolog annotations support ATP hydrolysis, ATP-dependent peptidase activity, zinc binding, and membrane localization; exact substrate specificity is not established from sequence alone.

entities.name: FtsH protease
observations: FtsH is a membrane-anchored AAA+ ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease with an N-terminal membrane domain and C-terminal cytoplasmic ATPase and protease modules.
Reviewed homologs are annotated as homohexamers involved in integral membrane protein quality control.
